note: dressing on the side, everything on the side

dish.make_ahead: Boil the eggs up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Wash the cos lettuces, dry well and tear into a large platter.
Arrange the leg ham, turkey, swiss cheese strips, halved eggs, tomatoes and cucumber in rows over the lettuce.
Pour the olive oil and red wine vinegar into two little jugs and serve them on the side.

note: whatever she's having

steps.text: Steam the pastrami over gently boiling water until glossy, soft and piping hot.
Spread the rye with mustard.
Pile the pastrami high on four slices and close the sandwiches.
Serve each with a pickle on the side.

film: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016)
note: Beef fillet wrapped in mushrooms, prosciutto and puff pastry

steps.text: Chop the mushrooms very fine and crush the garlic.
Sear the beef all over in hot oil, then brush with mustard and cool.
Cook the mushrooms with garlic until dry.
Lay prosciutto on a pastry sheet, spread with mushrooms and wrap around the beef, sealing with the second sheet. Brush with egg.
Bake at 210C.
Rest before slicing.

film: Close Encounters of the Third Kind (1977)
note: Buttery mash sculpted tall, with slow cooked onion gravy poured over

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes until soft.
Cook the onions slowly in some of the butter until golden.
Stir in the flour, add the stock and simmer for gravy.
Rice the potatoes and beat with the hot milk and the rest of the butter.
Pile into a tall mountain and pour the gravy over.

note: Crumbed pork fillet in a soft bun with pickles and slaw

dish.make_ahead: Crumb up to 2 hours ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the pork into pieces and pound each thin and wider than the bun.
Dust in flour, dip in beaten egg and press into crushed crackers mixed with panko.
Shallow fry at 180C until golden each side.
Toss shredded cabbage with mayonnaise and vinegar.
Serve in soft buns with mustard, mayo, pickles and sliced onion and the slaw on the side.

film: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York (1992)
note: charged to Dad's card

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, bake to serve

steps.text: Remove the lobster meat from the shells. Boil the macaroni and drain well.
Gently poach the lobster meat in some of the butter, then chop.
Melt more butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the warm milk and simmer. Stir in the Gruyere and cheddar.
Fold through the macaroni and lobster and tip into a baking dish.
Top with the panko mixed with melted butter and bake at 200C until golden.

note: Spicy ramen with kimchi, a cracked egg and melted cheese

steps.text: Bring the water to the boil with the gochugaru, the soy and a stock cube.
Cook the ramen noodles for 3 minutes, crack in the eggs and cover 1 minute.
Divide into bowls with the kimchi, sliced spring onions and a slice of cheese melting on top.

note: Seared sirloin, cracked pepper cream sauce, thin fries

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day for the sauce, fry chips fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries.
Fry the fries twice until crisp.
Sear the steaks to your liking and rest.
Toast the cracked peppercorns in the pan, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Serve the steak with the fries, sauce and a green salad.

note: the Irish wake supper

dish.make_ahead: Beef can be cooked 1 day ahead, keep chilled in its liquid

steps.text: Peel the onion, potatoes and carrots and cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks. Quarter the cabbage.
Cover the beef with water in a large pot with the onion, bay leaves and peppercorns and bring to a gentle simmer.
Simmer the beef gently, topping up the water as needed.
Add the potatoes and carrots and keep simmering.
Add the cabbage for the last of the cooking.
Slice the beef thick and serve with the vegetables, butter and mustard.

note: Garlic rosemary lamb shoulder roasted 5 hours, flatbreads, garlic yogurt

dish.make_ahead: Roast a day ahead, shred and reheat

ingredients.item: garlic clove, crushed, for the yoghurt
mixed vegetables for roasting (pumpkin, zucchini, red onion)

steps.text: Rub the lamb with the garlic, rosemary, paprika, oil and salt.
Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it pulls apart easily.
Roast the vegetables alongside for the last 40 minutes. Stir the garlic into the yoghurt.

note: Roast beef, crisp potatoes, honey carrots and pan gravy

dish.n: Mullins family roast beef and gravy

steps.text: Rub the beef with the mustard, garlic, a little oil and salt.
Parboil the potatoes, drain, rough up and toss in oil.
Roast the beef at 200C for medium rare, with the potatoes on a separate tray.
Toss the carrots in the honey and add for the last part of the roasting.
Rest the beef.
Whisk the flour into the pan juices, add the stock and simmer to a gravy.

note: Dark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage and okra, over rice

dish.n: Mama Boucher's chicken and sausage gumbo

steps.text: Stir the flour into the oil in a heavy pot over medium-low heat until the roux turns dark brown like chocolate.
Add the onion, celery and capsicum and cook until soft.
Add the chicken, sausage, Cajun seasoning and stock. Simmer.
Add the okra and cook until tender. Meanwhile steam the rice.
Serve over rice with spring onion and hot sauce.

note: Slow-grilled beef sausages and golden fried onions folded in white bread

dish.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Cook the sausages slowly over low coals or a barbecue, turning often.
Fry the onions in the butter on the hotplate until soft and golden.
Fold each sausage into bread with onions and sauce.

film: Back to the Future Part III (1990)
note: Beef chuck braised with onion, carrot and dark ale, crusty bread

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled, flavour improves

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150C. Season the beef and brown in batches in a heavy ovenproof pot.
Soften the sliced onions and chopped carrots in the same pot.
Return the beef, add the ale and stock and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in the oven until the beef falls apart.
Serve with the crusty bread for mopping up.

note: Slow braised beef and onion in Worcestershire gravy, baked in shortcrust

dish.n: Pie machine beef and onion pies
dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days, bake fresh

steps.text: Dice the beef and slice the onions.
Brown the beef in batches, add the onions, thyme, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and stock, cover and braise.
Thicken with cornflour mixed in water, then cool.
Line four pie tins with shortcrust, fill, top with puff and egg wash.
Bake at 200C.
Simmer the peas with the butter and mash roughly.

film: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga (2020)
note: Slow-roast lamb shoulder, sugar-glazed potatoes, gravy and buttered peas

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160C.
Rub the lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, thyme and the crushed garlic cloves and roast covered for 3 hours, uncovering for the last 30 minutes.
Boil the baby potatoes until tender and peel.
Melt the sugar in a pan until golden, add the butter and the potatoes and toss 5 minutes until glazed.
Make gravy from the pan juices, the flour, the red wine and the stock.
Serve with buttered peas.

film: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix (2007)
note: Chuck steak and lamb kidney in rich gravy under puff pastry

dish.n: Grimmauld Place steak and kidney pie
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake just before serving

steps.text: Trim and chop the steak and kidneys.
Brown the meat in batches.
Soften the onion.
Stir in the flour, stock and Worcestershire sauce.
Simmer until thick and tender.
Spoon into a pie dish, cool slightly and cover with the pastry.
Brush with egg and bake at 200C.

note: Two smashed beef patties with pickles and special sauce, twice-fried chips

steps.text: Mix the mayo, relish and mustard for the sauce. Cut the potatoes into chips.
Fry the chips at 140C, then again at 185C until crisp, and salt.
Roll the mince into eight balls and smash thin on a smoking griddle.
Top with cheese and stack two per toasted bun with pickles and sauce.

note: Grilled chicken thighs in a sticky teriyaki glaze, jasmine rice, bok choy

steps.text: Mix the soy, honey, chicken stock and sugar and marinate the chicken.
Marinate in the fridge.
Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through.
Reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Cook the rice and steam the bok choy.

note: Creamy jasmine rice porridge with prawns, lemongrass, ginger and bamboo

dish.make_ahead: Congee up to 2 days, add prawns when reheating

steps.text: Bruise the lemongrass and slice the ginger.
Simmer the rice in the stock with the lemongrass and ginger, stirring often, until creamy.
Peel the prawns.
Add the prawns and bamboo shoots for the last few minutes.
Top with chilli and a pinch of sugar.

note: Chicken thighs braised in red wine with bacon and mushrooms

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the chicken and bacon.
Add the mushrooms and cook until golden.
Pour in the wine and enough water to cover.
Simmer until rich and glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter and serve under the chicken.

note: an offer Clark can't quite refuse

steps.text: Dust the veal in seasoned flour and sear in butter and oil for 1 minute a side, then set aside.
Brown the mushrooms, add the marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the veal and warm through.

note: Garlic and rosemary studded lamb leg with roast potatoes and pan gravy

steps.text: Stud the lamb with garlic and rosemary and rub with oil, salt and pepper
Roast at 200C with the potatoes around it
Rest
Stir the flour into the pan juices, add the stock and simmer for gravy
Carve and serve

note: Clams, lobster tails, corn and potatoes steamed in white wine and garlic butter

steps.text: Halve the corn, crush the garlic and scrub the clams.
Boil the potatoes in a big pot.
Add the corn, wine, garlic and butter, then the clams and lobster tails. Cover and steam.
Tip it all onto the table.

note: Rolled turkey breast with bacon sage stuffing, roast potatoes and brussels sprouts

steps.text: Fry the bacon and onion with sage and breadcrumbs for a stuffing.
Butterfly the turkey breast, spread with stuffing, roll and tie.
Roast at 180C with the potatoes alongside.
Rest the turkey and roast the brussels sprouts.
Serve sliced with sprouts and cranberry sauce.

note: Pan seared chicken breast in white wine mushroom cream, mash and green beans

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash with some of the butter.
Brown the chicken in butter, then finish in a 200C oven.
Fry the mushrooms in the pan, add the wine and cream and reduce to a sauce.
Steam the beans and toss with butter.

note: Rice noodles with tofu, egg, tamarind and fish sauce, topped with peanuts and sprouts

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Soak the noodles in warm water until pliable, then drain.
Fry the tofu and garlic in the oil, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles, tamarind, fish sauce and brown sugar and toss until the noodles are tender.
Finish with bean sprouts, peanuts and a squeeze of lime.

note: Beef and kidney bean chili served in hollowed small pumpkins

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion and chilli powder
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer
Hollow the pumpkins
Roast the pumpkins at 200C
Fill with chilli, sour cream and cheddar

note: Beef goulash with sweet paprika and red pepper, over buttered egg noodles

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the beef in the oil in batches. Add the onions and paprika and stir for a minute.
Add the tomatoes, capsicum and enough water to cover.
Simmer for 3 hours until thick and tender.
Cook the noodles, toss with butter and serve the goulash over the top.

note: the dream down south

dish.make_ahead: Crumb up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel and butterfly the prawns, leaving the tails on.
Dust in flour, dip in beaten egg, then press into the panko mixed with coconut.
Fry in oil at 180C in batches until golden. Serve with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.

note: Chilli lime grilled fish in tortillas with fresh mango salsa

dish.n: Style Boyz fish tacos with mango salsa

steps.text: Rub the fish with the chilli powder, cumin, lime zest and oil.
Grill the fish, turning once, then flake.
Toss the mango, onion, chilli, lime juice and coriander for the salsa.
Blend the avocado with the sour cream and lime juice into a crema.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

note: Crisp breaded steak under creamy black pepper gravy

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter and some of the milk. Keep warm.
Pound the steaks thin and season the flour with salt and plenty of cracked pepper.
Dredge each steak in flour, then buttermilk, then flour again.
Shallow fry in hot oil until deep golden and crisp, then keep warm on a rack.
Whisk the gravy flour into the pan fat, add the remaining milk and lots of cracked pepper and simmer until thick.
Serve the steaks over the mash with the gravy.

note: Grilled cheddar burgers with grilled onion and pickles, twice fried chips

dish.n: Mudka's Meat Hut cheeseburger and chips

steps.text: Fry the potato chips once at a gentle heat until soft, then again hot until crisp.
Shape the mince into patties and grill hot.
Melt the cheddar on top and grill the onion.
Serve on toasted buns with pickles. Special for two, or four.

note: Roast salmon glazed with maple and wholegrain mustard, baby potatoes, green beans

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, roast the salmon fresh

steps.text: Mix the maple syrup and mustard and brush over the salmon.
Roast the salmon at 200C until just cooked through. While it roasts, boil the potatoes.
Steam the green beans, then toss with the potatoes and butter.
Serve everything together.

note: Crisp bacon and soft scrambled eggs on buttered white toast

dish.n: Bacon and scrambled eggs on toast

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Whisk the eggs with salt and scramble slowly in some of the butter until soft.
Toast and butter the bread.
Pile everything onto plates with a square of dark chocolate on the side.

note: Whole chicken with tarragon butter under the skin, roasted golden

dish.make_ahead: Dry-brine the night before

steps.text: The night before, salt the chicken and leave uncovered in the fridge.
Mix the softened butter with chopped tarragon and push it under the skin.
Roast at 220C with the halved potatoes.
Lower to 180C and roast until the thigh reads 72C.
Rest the chicken and make gravy from the pan juices and stock.
Cook the peas and toss with butter.

film: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid (1969)
note: Beef chuck braised with dried chilies and tomatoes, baked cornbread alongside

dish.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Add the chillies, cumin, garlic and tomatoes and braise until tender.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, buttermilk and egg into cornbread batter.
Bake the cornbread at 200C alongside.
Serve the chilli with cornbread.

note: for the Japanese restaurant scene where nobody takes their shoes off

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Cook the rice.
Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, brushing with glaze in the last minute.
Rest for 5 minutes, slice, and blanch the bok choy to serve alongside.

note: Seared sirloin in bourbon pepper cream sauce, with roast potatoes

steps.text: Roast the potatoes in oil at 220C.
Sear the steaks hard and rest.
Deglaze the pan with bourbon and crushed pepper.
Add the stock and cream and reduce.
Serve the steaks with potatoes and sauce.

note: Clams, prawns, smoked sausage, corn and potatoes steamed in one pot

steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot.
Add the corn, sausage, butter and a splash of water.
Add the clams and prawns, cover and steam for 8 minutes.
Tip it all onto the table.

note: Roast beef topside, Yorkshire puddings baked in muffin tins, roast potatoes

steps.text: Season the beef and rub with oil.
Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a batter and rest.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Roast the beef at 200C to medium.
Rest the beef under foil.
Meanwhile roast the potatoes in oil alongside the beef.
Pour the batter into hot oiled muffin tins and bake until puffed.
Cook the peas.
Make gravy from the pan juices, flour and stock.

note: Beef and parmesan meatballs in tomato sauce

dish.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days

ingredients.item: parmesan, grated, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Mix the mince with parmesan, parsley, salt and egg and roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs well.
Add the tomatoes, garlic and basil and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti.
Serve with extra parmesan on top.

note: Beef chuck braised 3 hours with carrots, celery and potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day

steps.text: Brown the beef hard on all sides in a heavy pot.
Add the onions, carrots, celery, stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours.
Add the potatoes and braise for the last hour.
Lift out the meat and veg. Thicken the juices with the flour into gravy.

note: Beef meatloaf wrapped in bacon and baked until glazed

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk, then mix with the mince, onion, egg, Worcestershire and salt.
Shape into a loaf on a lined tray and wrap with the bacon.
Bake at 180C, then brush with the tomato sauce mixed with the sugar and bake again.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and the rest of the milk.
Make gravy from the tray juices with the flour and stock.

note: Cheeseburger sliders with pickles and baked mac and cheese cups

dish.n: Sliders and mac and cheese party plate

steps.text: Cook the macaroni until just tender and drain.
Mix the macaroni with the cheese and milk and spoon into greased muffin tins.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Shape the mince into small patties and cook on both sides, topping with cheese to melt.
Serve in slider buns with pickles alongside the mac and cheese cups.

note: Seared T-bone topped with garlic butter, roast potatoes on the side

dish.n: Steak, and the bone for Hooch

steps.text: Halve the potatoes, toss in oil and roast at 220C.
Mash the butter with crushed garlic.
Sear the T-bones hard in a hot pan.
Finish in a 200C oven, then rest.
Steam the beans, top the steaks with garlic butter and save a bone for the dog.

note: Seared sirloin in peppercorn cream, mashed potato and steamed green beans

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes.
Sear the steaks hard in oil and rest.
Crush the peppercorns into the pan, add the cream and reduce until thick.
Mash the potatoes with butter and milk and steam the beans.
Serve on trays, airline style.

note: Seared rib eye, buttery mashed potatoes, green beans and red wine jus

dish.n: Joi's rib eye, mash and red wine jus

steps.text: Boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
Reduce the red wine with stock into a jus.
Sear the steaks hard.
Rest and slice the steaks.
Steam the green beans.
Plate it like a proper dinner and pour the jus over.

note: Thick seared chuck patties with fried onions and melted cheddar

steps.text: Shape the mince into thick patties.
Fry the sliced onions in oil until golden.
Sear the patties hard on a hot grill on both sides.
Melt a slice of cheddar on each patty.
Toast the buns and stack with onions and barbecue sauce.

note: Rosemary garlic lamb chops grilled hot, served with corn

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Marinate the lamb chops for 1 hour with the chopped rosemary, the garlic cloves, the juice of the lemon and the oil.
Grill over high heat 3 minutes a side.
Grill the corn cobs for 10 minutes alongside and brush with butter.

film: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom (1984)
note: Yogurt marinated lamb shoulder braised with onions and tomato

dish.make_ahead: Marinate overnight, curry keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Mix the lamb with the yoghurt, ginger, garlic and garam masala.
Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Cook the onions slowly in oil until deep brown.
Add the tomatoes, then the lamb with its marinade. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours 30 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve with the curry.

note: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce over spaghetti with parmesan

ingredients.item: slices white bread, soaked in milk

steps.text: Mix the minces with the soaked bread, parmesan and parsley
Roll into balls
Brown the meatballs
Simmer in the tomatoes
Cook the spaghetti
Toss with the sauce and more parmesan

note: Dry rubbed brisket cooked 8 hours until it wobbles, with white bread and pickles

dish.make_ahead: Cook the day before, slice cold and reheat

steps.text: Rub the brisket with salt, pepper and paprika.
Wrap tightly.
Cook at 140C until it wobbles.
Rest for an hour.
Slice thick and serve with white bread, pickles and barbecue sauce.

note: Pepperoni, ham, bacon and Italian sausage pizza on barbecue sauce

steps.text: Stretch the dough into two rounds on oiled trays.
Mix the pizza sauce with the barbecue sauce and spread over the bases. Scatter with mozzarella.
Top with pepperoni, ham, bacon and sausage squeezed from the skins in small pieces.
Bake at 240C until the crust is golden and the meat is crisp.

film: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem (2023)
note: Thin crust pizza with mozzarella and pepperoni, folded to eat

steps.text: Stretch the dough thin on a floured tray.
Spread with pizza sauce and scatter with mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano.
Bake on a very hot tray at 250C.
Cut into big slices and fold each in half to eat.

film: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers (2002)
note: Rabbit or chicken stewed with ale, carrots and potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the meat in batches.
Add the onions, carrots and thyme and soften.
Add the ale, stock and potatoes.
Simmer covered until tender.

note: the farm weekend upstate

dish.make_ahead: Salt the chicken the night before

steps.text: Salt the chicken and refrigerate uncovered overnight to dry-brine.
Mix the butter with lemon zest and thyme and push under the skin.
Roast at 220C with the potatoes in the tray.
Lower to 180C and roast until cooked through.
Rest before carving.

note: Lager-battered flathead, slaw, chipotle crema in warm tortillas

steps.text: Soak the onion in the juice of two limes with a pinch of salt.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and lager to a batter.
Dip the fish in batter and fry at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Toss the cabbage with lime juice and salt. Mix the sour cream with the chipotle sauce.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, crema, onion and coriander.

note: Crusty potato and corned beef hash topped with a fried egg

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat in a hot pan

steps.text: Dice the potatoes, onion and corned beef.
Boil the potatoes, then drain well.
Fry the onion in butter and oil.
Add the potatoes and corned beef and press flat.
Cook over medium-high heat, turning in sections, until crusty.
Splash with Worcestershire and add chopped parsley.
Fry the eggs and sit one on each serve with brown sauce.

note: two beef patties, special sauce, sesame seed bun

steps.text: Mix the mayonnaise, relish, mustard, paprika and vinegar for the sauce.
Shape the mince into 8 thin patties.
Smash the patties in a hot pan and add the cheese.
Toast the buns.
Build each with sauce, lettuce, onion, pickles and patties in the three-piece bun.

note: Seared rump, Swiss cheese, jammy onions, rocket and mustard mayo

dish.n: Steak sandwich and a steak sandwich

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in the butter and sugar until jammy.
Bat the steaks to about 1cm thick, season and sear in a very hot pan.
Lay the cheese on the steaks and cover briefly to melt.
Toast the rolls. Mix the mayonnaise with the mustard.
Build each roll with mayo, rocket, tomato, steak and onions. Make two each.

note: Grilled beef patties, American cheese, pickle sauce and lettuce

steps.text: Shape the beef mince into patties slightly wider than the buns and season well.
Grill on a hot barbecue 4 minutes a side, adding the slices of American cheese each for the last minute.
Mix the mayo, the tomato sauce, the mustard and the chopped dill pickles.
Toast the sesame buns, spread with sauce, add shredded lettuce, the patty and sliced pickles.

note: Tarragon butter roast chicken, silky mashed potatoes, Dijon-dressed leaves

dish.make_ahead: Rest 15 minutes before carving

steps.text: Mix the butter with tarragon and push under the chicken skin.
Roast at 220C, then drop to 180C.
Rest and carve.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter until silky.
Whisk the oil, mustard and vinegar and toss through the leaves.

note: Smoked paprika brisket cubes roasted low and tossed in barbecue sauce

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat covered

steps.text: Cut the brisket into 4cm cubes
Rub with smoked paprika and salt
Roast at 140C
Toss with barbecue sauce and brown sugar
Return to the oven until sticky

note: Grilled lemon oregano chicken thighs with brown rice and broccoli

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil and coat the chicken.
Marinate for an hour.
Cook the brown rice.
Grill the chicken over high heat until charred and cooked through.
Steam the broccoli florets.
Serve with an extra squeeze of lemon.

note: Crisp chips with cheese curds and hot beef gravy

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook until nutty.
Whisk in the stock, Worcestershire and pepper and simmer until glossy.
Tear the cheese into pieces. Pile the hot chips into bowls, scatter the cheese over and pour the very hot gravy on top.

note: Beef chuck braised with bacon, baby onions and mushrooms

dish.n: Bell tower beef and mushroom braise
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Dice the bacon and beef and peel the baby onions.
Brown the bacon, then the beef in batches.
Add the onions and mushrooms and colour lightly.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then add the stock, vinegar, thyme and bay leaves.
Cover and simmer gently until the beef is tender.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and warm milk.
Serve the braise over the mash.

note: Lemon, garlic and oregano lamb shoulder roasted 5 hours, potato wedges in the juices

dish.n: Karamitsos family lamb on the spit
dish.make_ahead: Rest 20 minutes before pulling

steps.text: Rub the lamb with the lemon juice, garlic, oregano, oil and salt.
Roast covered at 150C.
Add the potato wedges to the pan for the last 90 minutes.
Uncover to brown.
Rest and serve.

note: Chips topped with cheese curds and hot beef gravy

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips.
Fry at 140C until soft and pale.
Cook the butter and flour for 2 minutes, whisk in the stock and simmer until thick.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp.
Pile chips into bowls, scatter the cheese curds and pour the hot gravy over.
